Subject: Mathematics
QuestionText: A can do a piece of work in 12 days and B in 18 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
Explanation: Combined rate = 1/12 + 1/18 = 5/36 per day, so time = 36/5 = 7.2 days.

Subject: Reasoning
QuestionText: Pointing to a photograph, Ravi said, 'She is the daughter of my grandfather's only son.' How is the girl in the photograph related to Ravi?
Explanation: Grandfather's only son is Ravi's father, so his daughter is Ravi's sister.

Subject: English
QuestionText: Choose the word most similar in meaning to 'AUDACIOUS'.
Explanation: Audacious means showing willingness to take bold risks; bold is the closest synonym.

Subject: General Awareness
QuestionText: Which article of the Indian Constitution deals with the Right to Constitutional Remedies?
Explanation: Article 32 empowers citizens to move the Supreme Court for enforcement of Fundamental Rights; Dr. Ambedkar called it the 'heart and soul' of the Constitution.
